Hey everyone out there in Creature Land! Sadly, I write to you all today to inform you that Kevin is departing from the group. We thought it only fair to give you guys a brief rundown of the reasons as to why this has happened. Like with most situations, we ask that you respect everyone’s privacy in the matter. Kevin will be making a video of the reasons in his own words that you can watch on his channel. Kevin, getting out here about a half year ago was in plenty of Creature content, but felt that this environment and schedule wasn’t working out for him. After thinking about it, he decided that he wanted to continue pursuing his own channel and streaming. We did not want to hold him back in any way, so encouraged him to do so. He has been streaming more consistently on his twitch channel now, so as friends and colleagues, we wish him the best of luck on his new adventure. We can’t wait to see how he does working on his own projects and channels. I encourage you to go watch his video concerning these events so you can hear everything from his point of view. We continue to have big plans for the Hub, and while we can never hope to fill the shoes of Kevin, we look forward to our team growing still. We will continue to do our best to provide you guys with the most entertaining content possible and can’t thank everyone enough for supporting us in this journey. So thank you so much to Kevin for joining us on such an amazing ride! And fans, please thank him as well and wish him luck on his future endeavors. -Cat Man Kevin's vid: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B_SGmK2Xq7w
